slides.text: We had the notorious 'Whisper Killer' dead to rights. He sat in the interrogation room, handcuffed to the steel table, smiling a placid, terrifying smile. For three hours, my partner and I grilled him about the location of his seventh victim. He refused to speak. Finally, I slammed my fists on the table. 'We have your DNA, your car, the murder weapon. You're going to the chair. Just tell us where the girl is.'

He leaned forward, the chains rattling against the metal. 'Detective, I'll make a deal. I will give you the exact coordinates of the girl, but you have to let me make one phone call.' My partner scoffed, but we were desperate. Time was running out. I slid my personal cell phone across the table. The killer dialed a number with handcuffed, awkward fingers. He put it on speaker. The room fell dead silent as it rang.

The ringing echoed through the cramped room. Suddenly, a muffled vibration started. I looked down. The buzzing was coming from inside my partner's jacket pocket. My partner's face drained of color as he slowly pulled out a ringing burner phone. The killer looked at me, his smile widening into something truly demonic. 'I told you I'd tell you where she is, Detective,' he whispered. 'Why don't you ask the man sitting next to you?'
